condition: uncomplicated acute lactational breast inflammation at 3 weeks postpartum presenting with a warm tender wedge-shaped red outer left breast area and 101 F fever
level_rationale: Developing a warm tender wedge-shaped red patch on the outer side of the left breast accompanied by a 101 F fever today at 3 weeks postpartum in a breastfeeding mother describes uncomplicated acute lactational breast inflammation warranting a same-day outpatient physician visit for clinical breast examination, continued lactation guidance, and targeted oral antibiotic therapy if indicated rather than emergency department admission, whereas the left breast feeling slightly full before a feeding today and softening right after nursing represents normal physiological postpartum milk letdown needing only routine self-care.
